notes.title: Firework English version available now!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Thank you for your attention and patience to Firework. Today, we're thrilled to annnounce that English is finally added to Firework officially!

Set in a remote Chinese mountain town, you will step into the shoes of rookie detective Lin Lixun. Tasked with investigating a previously closed case that saw the death of a whole family, Lin must uncover what truly happened - was it a supernatural phenomenon or an elaborate murder?

We really hope you could experience the story by yourself so we won't say too much.

You can join our Discord to share your thoughts with other users.
[url=https://discord.gg/T5asSnnY][/url]

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Firework English version delayed announcement
notes.notes:
Dear players，

At the recently concluded Tokyo Game Show, we announced that the English version of Firework would be released on October 21 for multiple platforms.

However, we have encountered some difficulties in multi-platform compatibility testing and still have a distance to go. Therefore, we still have to address this issue until it is worked well on each of the platforms, and the launch of Firework has to be delayed.
The specific launch time will be announced in the follow-up announcement. We promise not to keep you wait too long.

We sincerely apologize to all the players.

The short delay is for a better reunion. We look forward to communicating with you about the Firework English version.
Thank you for your continued support of Firework!

notes.title: Firework’s English patch will be released on Oct 21st, 2021.
notes.notes:
Since the Chinese version of the game was released in February the game has sold over 300,000 units and it has maintained a 98% positive review rate. We really appreciate your support.

Since the English language wasn’t ready at release, unfortunately players from the rest of the world couldn’t enjoy the exciting story on release. Now, after months of hard work we are proud to announce that the English version will be ready very soon for everyone.

We hope that more players are able to enjoy this game in a more convenient way and be able to enjoy this deep story.

We believe that the emotions transmitted by the game can go beyond any cultural barriers since every player will be able to feel a connection to it by this deep and touching story.

We hope you enjoy Firework!

notes.title: Firework Now Available on Steam. English Version on the way!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Firework have officially launched its Chinese language version. Thank you for all of your support!
For English version, we have started to work with native English polish team, strive to deliver the original poem story of Firework to you. 

Stay tuned to get our latest update on the process of English version.

Thank you for support Firework!

Shiying Studio & Gamera Game

notes.title: Firework will release on 4th February, 2021
notes.notes:
On February 4, 2021, the full version of "Firework" will release on Steam, one playthrough will take about 3 hours. The English version will be available later after the release. 

Currently Firework development has entered the final polishing stage. We've seen lots of discussions and analysis of the plot since the Demo was released, and we believe that the complete version will be worth your wait. 

Thanks for all of your support to Shiying Studio and Gamera Game. We wish you a good 2021 and a happy new year.
